telemetry_consent.heading: Help improve Veyrnox
telemetry_consent.body: Share anonymous usage data so we can fix bugs and improve the experience. No personal info, no balances, no wallet addresses, no tracking across apps.
telemetry_consent.device_id_note: A random device ID is used — never linked to your wallet, keys, or identity. You can change this anytime in Settings → Privacy.

rasp.heading: RASP Security
rasp.subhead: Runtime risk detection & honest degradation — environment-risk plane
rasp.banner_body: Before every signature the app checks its runtime for automation, hooking, tampering, root / jailbreak, and emulator signals. A clean environment signs normally; a compromised one is refused.
rasp.ladder_heading: How a risky environment is handled:

ladder.warn: Rooted / jailbroken — you confirm the risk before signing
ladder.block: Hooking / tamper / emulator — signing refused, no override

rasp.footer: No fake event counts or scan buttons — only real detections shown.

panic.heading: Panic Wipe
panic.subhead: Wipe all wallet data from this device. Permanent. No undo.
panic.permanent_banner_body: Everything on this device is deleted. You cannot undo this.
panic.how_pin_body: — set one below. Enter it at the unlock screen and everything deletes instantly with no confirmation. A pop-up dialog under pressure could give you away.
panic.how_now_body: — for selling or retiring a device. Type {{word}} and tick the box below.
scope_deleted_items: Your main wallet, any Emergency wallet, and all hidden wallets on this device.
All local wallet data and the on-device database.
scope_kept_items: Any recovery phrase you wrote down or saved elsewhere. You can restore from that anytime.
Your transaction history on the blockchain. Public records stay public.
Honest limit: we clear the wallet records, but someone examining the storage chip itself may still find traces.
panic.setup_warning: ⚠️ This PIN must be different from your real PIN, Emergency PIN, and any hidden wallet secret. If it matches one, that wallet opens instead and nothing gets wiped. We cannot check this for you. Entering this PIN at unlock permanently deletes your wallet.
panic.pin_saved_ok: Wipe PIN saved. Enter it at the unlock screen to wipe this device.
panic.pin_error_length: Panic/wipe PIN must be exactly 8 digits
panic.remove_prompt: Changed your mind? Remove the wipe PIN without triggering anything.
panic.remove_confirm_body: Your wipe PIN is cleared. You won't be able to trigger a wipe from the unlock screen after this.
panic.wipe_now_body_lead: Deletes every wallet on this device right now.
panic.wipe_now_body_backup: Save your recovery phrase somewhere safe before doing this if you want to restore later.
panic.wipe_now_ack: I understand this permanently deletes all wallets on this device. Only a recovery phrase backup can restore them.
panic.wipe_now_done: Done. Wallet data on this device is cleared — though traces may remain on the storage chip.
panic.demo_body: Sets up a throwaway real wallet ({{real}}), an Emergency wallet ({{duress}}), a hidden wallet ({{hidden}}), and a wipe PIN ({{panic}}). Step 1 snapshots local wallet data; step 2 enters the wipe PIN at the unlock screen; then it snapshots again to show the vault store is empty.
panic.demo_clean_confirm: Checked: the vault store is now empty and no address data remains.
panic.non_demo_hint: Lock your wallet and enter the wipe PIN at the unlock screen. Everything deletes instantly — no confirmation. Keep your recovery phrase somewhere safe if you ever want to restore.
